Indian Navy Agniveer SSR/ MR Stage II Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Join Indian Navy has released the Stage II Admit Card for the post of Navy Agniveer SSR | MR 01/2027 & 02/2027 Batch. Applications for the Indian Navy Agniveer SSR/ MR Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 14 March 2026 to 06 April 2026. Candidates who qualified for this stage I examination can download their Indian Navy Agniveer SSR/ MR Stage II Admit Card 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 10 March 2026
  • Application Start : 14 March 2026
  • Last Date : 06 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 April 2026
  • Correction Form : 10-11 April 2026
  • Stage I Exam Date (SSR) : 13 May 2026
  • Stage I Exam Date (MR) : 14-15 May 2026
  • Exam City / Admit Card : 30 April 2026
  • Result : 17 September 2026
  • Stage II Admit Card : 17 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 550/- +18% GST
  • SC, ST : Rs. 550/- +18% GST
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
